answer: Each agent identity requires a 60-unit stake and a one-per-hardware credential that the registry issues once per device. To forge N identities an attacker must lock 60N units, lose 90 percent of every stake on detection, and wait four epochs before any refund clears. Copying a credential to spawn an echo or splitting a bond across identities fails because marginal cost scales with each fake, the shared penalty drains the whole cluster, and independent jurors trace the duplicate lotus credential to its source.
